summary: Mybucks.online is a browser-based, password-only cryptocurrency wallet that lets you maintain self-custody of your digital assets. Built under an MIT licence, it provides an interface for managing funds directly from your web browser without relying on third-party custodians.
goodFor: It is well-suited for users looking for a straightforward, self-hosted web interface to manage their own cryptocurrency keys.
watchOut: The project shows signs of slowing development activity, meaning you may need to rely on community support or your own resources for troubleshooting and security patches.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application, it typically requires a reverse proxy such as Nginx or Caddy to handle TLS termination, along with a process manager to keep the service running.
